verdict.conclusion_limit: Zero confirmed incompatibilities is a bounded source-inspection finding. Preserved source definitions and matching selected bytes/modes do not prove runtime correctness, application of migrations, successful current ROOT builds/tests, or final ROOT acceptance.

end_re_read.comparison_rule: stable means equal raw byte count, SHA-256, mode and type; equal size/mtime/ctime/inode metadata; and metadata stable within both reads. An ENOENT absence at both ends is separately recorded as stable absence.
